prompt: I want to query my todos reactively in a Flutter StreamBuilder — only show items where done=false, sorted by due date.
expected_output: Shows todos.query().where((t) => !t.obj.done).orderBy((t) => t.obj.due).watch() inside StreamBuilder. Mentions on-device execution. May mention wherePath as a typed alternative.
assertions: Includes .orderBy() for sorting by due date
Mentions that queries run on-device (not server-side)
